description: A same-host stylesheet URL redirects (302) to the CDN, which answers 404: critical silently drops it.

thin.note: The host of the LAST URL requested for the stylesheet (after redirects) is compared with the host of the final page URL: here the CDN, so the failure is skipped with one warning. If the host written in the page decided instead (the page host), this would fail the job. (In these fixtures {{site}} and {{cdn}} share the hostname 127.0.0.1 and differ only by port: the stylesheet same-host rule compares hostname:port with the scheme ignored, the notion the url() rebasing uses.)
